dashboard.title: SOC 2 readiness controls
dashboard.subtitle: Internal view of control status and evidence freshness. Staff only.
dashboard.notice: This is readiness tracking, not a SOC 2 report. Vireek has not completed an audit. “Met” means implemented in the repository with automated evidence; it does not mean audited.

error.title: Could not load controls
error.body: The control list could not be loaded. You may not have staff access, or the database migration has not been applied.

empty.title: No controls synced yet
empty.body: Run the “sync” step of the evidence workflow to load docs/compliance/soc2/controls.json into the database.

table.caption: SOC 2 controls with declared status and evidence state

claims.heading: What we can show evidence for
claims.intro: Each item is marked “Evidenced” only while automated checks keep confirming it. Anything else stays “In progress”.
claims.footnote: This is not a SOC 2 report or certification. Vireek has not completed a SOC 2 audit.

tenant_isolation_rls.title: Account isolation in the database
tenant_isolation_rls.body: Every application table has row-level security enabled, checked automatically.

automated_security_scanning.title: Automated security scanning
automated_security_scanning.body: Dependency audit, code analysis and secret scanning run on a schedule and on code changes, with no critical or high findings past our target fix times.

automated_ci_checks.title: Automated checks on code changes
automated_ci_checks.body: Linting, type checks, tests and builds run automatically, and recent runs on the main branch are passing.

availability_monitoring.title: Continuous call-answering monitoring
availability_monitoring.body: Synthetic test calls and service-level objectives monitor whether the AI answers calls; probes ran within the last day.

vulnerability_disclosure.title: Security contact and disclosure policy
vulnerability_disclosure.body: A security.txt file and a vulnerability disclosure page are published and current.

backup_and_restore_testing.title: Backups and restore testing
backup_and_restore_testing.body: Application backups complete at least daily and a restore drill has passed within the last eight days.

enforced_mfa_for_staff.title: Multi-factor authentication for Vireek staff
enforced_mfa_for_staff.body: Every Vireek staff account has a verified second factor enrolled.

independent_penetration_test.title: Independent penetration test
independent_penetration_test.body: A third-party penetration test has been completed and recorded.

policies.title: Policy approvals
policies.subtitle: Who approved which version of each policy, when, and which staff have acknowledged it. Staff only.
policies.notice: This records internal approvals. It is readiness tracking, not a SOC 2 report or certification. All policies stay drafts until a named person approves them; a self-approval is flagged and is not independent review.

error.title: Could not load policies
error.body: Check your connection and permissions, then retry.

empty.title: No policies registered
empty.body: Run the compliance evidence workflow (sync-policies) to register the files in docs/compliance/policies.

submit.title: Submit a version
submit.hashMissing: The repository hash for this policy has not been synced yet.

approve.selfWarning: You submitted this version. Approving it will be recorded as self-approval and will not count as independent review.
approve.selfConfirm: I understand and want to record a self-approval
approve.mismatch: The policy text no longer matches what was submitted. Withdraw and submit again.

ack.you: You have not acknowledged this version

errors.version_not_newer: The version must be higher than the latest existing one.
errors.summary_too_long: The summary is longer than 300 characters.
errors.hash_not_synced: The policy hash has not been synced from the repository.
errors.already_in_review: A version is already in review.

workforce.title: Workforce completion records
workforce.notice: Record only that a step was completed. Never enter results, findings, reports, notes, dates of birth, ID numbers or documents: those stay with the provider. Background checks are not required until management decides; lawfulness varies by country and role [COUNSEL].

matrix.title: Status by staff member
matrix.caption: Workforce requirements by active staff account

errors.course_not_allowed: A course applies only to training.
errors.date_future: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.date_too_old: The date is more than five years ago.
errors.valid_until_before: Valid-until must not be before the completion date.
errors.waiver_not_allowed: A waiver reason applies only to waived records.
errors.provider_invalid: Use a plain label without emails, long numbers or markup.
errors.reference_invalid: Use 3–64 letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

pentest.title: Penetration test program
pentest.subtitle: Engagements, findings and remediation deadlines. Staff only.
pentest.notice: Readiness tracking only. It does not mean a test has happened, and nothing here may be presented to customers as a test result. Details of findings stay in the vendor report; only neutral titles and pointers are stored here.

banner.none: No penetration test has been performed or reported.
banner.done: At least one report has been received. Statuses below are internal tracking.

error.title: Could not load the program
error.body: Check your connection and permissions, then retry.

findings.title: Findings
findings.caption: Penetration test findings with remediation deadlines
findings.title_f: Neutral title (no exploit details, no URLs)
findings.fixRef: Fix pointer, e.g. PR or ticket (optional)

slaTable.title: Proposed remediation targets
slaTable.note: Proposed internal targets, not customer commitments; the security owner must approve them before they are cited.

errors.vendor_required: A vendor is required at this stage.
errors.window_order: The end date is before the start date.
errors.scope_required: Select at least one scope area.
errors.report_date_required: A report date is required at this stage.
errors.title_has_url: Do not put URLs in titles.
errors.cvss_range: The score must be between 0.0 and 10.0.
errors.severity_mismatch: The severity does not match the CVSS score.
errors.vendor_ref_invalid: Use letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (max 40).
errors.fix_ref_invalid: Use a PR number, ticket id or path without spaces.
errors.date_future: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.acceptance_required: A risk acceptance needs an approver and a later expiry date.
errors.isolation_floor: The tenant-isolation floor applies only to critical or high.
